lines.zh: 我逆着河流游，彩色尾巴摆得飞快。
lines.en: I swim upstream, my colored tail beating fast.

lines.zh: 我们三条挤在水草边，谁也不让谁。
lines.en: Three of us crowd the weeds, and no one gives way.

lines.zh: 热带的河水是暖的，暖得让人想动。
lines.en: The tropical river is warm, warm enough to make you move.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里穿来穿去，身子不到七厘米。
lines.en: I weave through the stones, under seven centimeters long.

lines.zh: 阳光照进浅水，我的鳞片全亮了。
lines.en: Sunlight enters the shallows, and every scale lights up.

lines.zh: 我追一片落叶，追了整整两格。
lines.en: I chase a fallen leaf for two whole blocks.

lines.zh: 水流急，我就贴着河底走。
lines.en: When the current is strong, I keep to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我躲开一条大鱼，它根本没看见我。
lines.en: I dodge a big fish, and it never even saw me.

lines.zh: 河湾那块水最暖，我们都在那儿。
lines.en: The bend holds the warmest water, and we all gather there.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾就冲出去，小，但是快。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I am off, small but quick.

lines.zh: 我们从芦苇根下游过，一根一根数。
lines.en: We pass the reed roots, counting them one by one.

lines.zh: 水浅的时候，我的背几乎露出水面。
lines.en: In shallow water my back nearly breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 同伴转了个弯，我紧跟着转。
lines.en: A schoolmate turns, and I turn right behind it.

lines.zh: 河水一直流，我一直游，不觉得累。
lines.en: The river keeps flowing and I keep swimming, never tired.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底的卵石滑过去。
lines.en: I skim over the pebbles on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 一根水草拦住我，我从下面绕。
lines.en: A water weed blocks me. I go underneath.

lines.zh: 我们两条并排，尾巴摆得一样快。
lines.en: Two of us side by side, tails beating in time.

lines.zh: 水面上的光斑跟着我一起动。
lines.en: The light spots on the surface move with me.

lines.zh: 我停在水草叶上，尾巴还在轻轻摆。
lines.en: I rest on a weed leaf, my tail still swaying.

lines.zh: 阳光在水底画方格，我站在格子里。
lines.en: Sunlight draws squares on the bottom, and I sit in one.

lines.zh: 我们三条悬着，一动不动。
lines.en: The three of us hang there, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我吐了个小泡，它浮上去破了。
lines.en: I blow a small bubble; it rises and pops.

lines.zh: 热带的水很软，我不用费力。
lines.en: Tropical water is soft, and I need no effort.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，让彩色的那面朝光。
lines.en: I turn my colored side toward the light.

lines.zh: 一朵水花落下来，我退开半寸。
lines.en: A splash falls, and I move back half an inch.

lines.zh: 河流有声音，听久了像在说话。
lines.en: The river has a sound; after a while it seems to speak.

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，所以我很轻。
lines.en: I have only one point of life, so I am light.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼一片藻，要嚼很久。
lines.en: I chew a bit of algae slowly, for a long time.

lines.zh: 同伴碰了我一下，我懒得动。
lines.en: A schoolmate nudges me, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 傍晚水会转凉，我知道。
lines.en: The water cools at dusk, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我看水面的天，看不清楚。
lines.en: I look at the sky through the surface and cannot see it well.

lines.zh: 这条河我生在这里，也会死在这里。
lines.en: I was born in this river, and I will die in it.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，脸比我整个人还大。
lines.en: You crouch down, and your face is larger than all of me.

lines.zh: 你的倒影压过来，我钻进水草。
lines.en: Your reflection bears down, and I slip into the weeds.

lines.zh: 我从叶缝里露出半条尾巴看你。
lines.en: I show half a tail through the leaves and watch you.

lines.zh: 你的手指伸进水里，我围着它转。
lines.en: Your fingers enter the water, and I circle them.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，水面在抖。
lines.en: When you laugh, the surface shivers.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，你的动作太慢了。
lines.en: I do not fear you; you move too slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里那只小网，我见过。
lines.en: I have seen that little net in your hand before.

lines.zh: 我浮到水面，正对着你的眼睛。
lines.en: I rise to the surface, level with your eye.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道和河水不一样。
lines.en: You smell different from the river.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，我只有一只眼那么大。
lines.en: You watch me, I watch you, and I am the size of one eye.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，整条鱼都翻白了。
lines.en: I take a hit, and my whole body flashes pale.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，只有一点点。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water, only a little.

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，这一下就去了一半。
lines.en: I have one point of life, and that took half.

lines.zh: 我拼命游，可这条河太长。
lines.en: I swim desperately, but the river is long.

lines.zh: 我的彩尾被咬掉一截，颜色还在。
lines.en: A piece of my colored tail is gone, but the color stays.

lines.zh: 疼得我撞进水草，卡在里面。
lines.en: The pain drives me into the weeds, and I stick there.

lines.zh: 谁打我？水里只有晃动的光。
lines.en: Who hit me? There is only shaking light in the water.

lines.zh: 我翻过来，又挣扎着正回去。
lines.en: I roll over and struggle upright again.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，连呼吸都放轻。
lines.en: I hide in a crack and make my breathing small.

lines.zh: 这一点疼，对我是很大的事。
lines.en: This little pain is a very big thing to me.

lines.zh: 你撒下的饵碎，落在水草上。
lines.en: The crumbs you scatter settle on the weeds.

lines.zh: 我游过去，先闻了闻。
lines.en: I swim over and sniff it first.

lines.zh: 那么小一块，够我吃很久。
lines.en: Such a small piece, enough for a long while.

lines.zh: 我知道钩在附近，可我真的饿了。
lines.en: I know a hook is near, but I am truly hungry.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，钩穿过我的嘴。
lines.en: I bite once, and the hook passes through my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的拉力只有零点二，你几乎没感觉。
lines.en: My pull is two tenths; you hardly feel it.

lines.zh: 你在桶里放的面包屑，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the breadcrumbs you put in the bucket.

lines.zh: 我绕着那团东西转了七圈。
lines.en: I circle that lump seven times.

lines.zh: 太香了，整条河都是这个味道。
lines.en: It smells so good the whole river tastes of it.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，比那粒饵还小。
lines.en: I open my mouth, and it is smaller than the bait.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的手指上，弹了回来。
lines.en: I bump your finger and bounce back.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进河里，泥扬起来。
lines.en: Your boot enters the river, and mud billows up.

lines.zh: 我从网眼里钻过去，刮掉两片鳞。
lines.en: I squeeze through the mesh and lose two scales.

lines.zh: 桶里的水晃，我撞在壁上。
lines.en: The bucket water sloshes, and I strike the wall.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我一下，我转头撞回去。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps me, and I turn and bump back.

lines.zh: 你涉水过来，我贴着你的脚背游过。
lines.en: You wade over, and I glide across your instep.

lines.zh: 水流把我推到石头上，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The current pushes me into a stone and I roll over.

lines.zh: 我太小了，撞你像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: I am so small that hitting you is like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 水面一动，我就知道有东西下来了。
lines.en: The surface stirs, and I know something is coming down.

lines.zh: 我们三条撞成一团，又散开。
lines.en: The three of us tangle and then come apart.

lines.zh: 我追着它的彩尾，从河湾追到石桥。
lines.en: I chase its colored tail from the bend to the stone bridge.

lines.zh: 它的颜色比我的艳，我认了。
lines.en: Its colors are brighter than mine, and I accept that.

lines.zh: 我们贴着水草，尾巴交在一起。
lines.en: We press against the weeds, tails crossed.

lines.zh: 小鱼会直接生下来，不用等卵。
lines.en: The fry come out live; there are no eggs to wait for.

lines.zh: 它躲，我追，河水帮着我们。
lines.en: It hides, I chase, and the river helps us both.

lines.zh: 我绕它转了三圈，它才停。
lines.en: I circle it three times before it stops.

lines.zh: 我们找了一处水最暖的角落。
lines.en: We find the warmest corner of the water.

lines.zh: 它的肚子鼓起来了，我知道成了。
lines.en: Its belly swells, and I know it worked.

lines.zh: 之后它就不理我了，鱼都这样。
lines.en: Afterward it ignores me, as fish do.

lines.zh: 一窝能有几十条，比这条河还热闹。
lines.en: A brood can be dozens, noisier than the river.

lines.zh: 我叼走一粒面包屑，比我的头还大。
lines.en: I carry off a breadcrumb bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 落叶沉下来，我咬了一口，不好吃。
lines.en: A leaf sinks; I bite it, and it tastes bad.

lines.zh: 我把小石子当成食物，吐了出来。
lines.en: I mistake a pebble for food and spit it out.

lines.zh: 水面的花瓣，我推着玩了半天。
lines.en: I push a floating petal around for ages.

lines.zh: 那根水草太粗，我拉不动。
lines.en: That weed stem is too thick for me to pull.

lines.zh: 我捡到一片鳞，是别人的。
lines.en: I find a scale, and it belongs to someone else.

lines.zh: 饵碎沉底，我第一个到。
lines.en: When crumbs sink, I am the first to arrive.

lines.zh: 我含着一粒沙，腮一鼓一鼓。
lines.en: I hold a grain of sand while my gills puff.

lines.zh: 掉下来的小虫，我抢到了。
lines.en: A small insect fell, and I got it.

lines.zh: 我从不挑食，能吃就吃。
lines.en: I am not picky; if it can be eaten, I eat it.

lines.zh: 一只水蚤在动，我看见了。
lines.en: A water flea moves, and I see it.

lines.zh: 上游漂下来一团东西，我盯住了。
lines.en: Something drifts down from upstream, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 那点白比水草亮，肯定能吃。
lines.en: That white speck is brighter than the weeds, so it must be food.

lines.zh: 我锁定了落水的小虫。
lines.en: I lock onto an insect that fell in.

lines.zh: 同伴也看见了，我们同时冲。
lines.en: A schoolmate sees it too, and we rush at once.

lines.zh: 我盯上一片藻，虽然它不会跑。
lines.en: I fix on a bit of algae, though it will not run.

lines.zh: 我发现了你的饵，也发现了钩。
lines.en: I found your bait, and I found the hook.

lines.zh: 一只孑孓在水里扭，我感兴趣了。
lines.en: A wriggler twists in the water, and I take interest.

lines.zh: 我看准了才动，我只有一次机会。
lines.en: I look before I move; I get one chance only.

lines.zh: 目标在叶子下面，我绕过去。
lines.en: The target is under a leaf, and I go around.

lines.zh: 我悬在它上方，尾巴慢慢摆。
lines.en: I hang above it, tail swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 水面稍有动静，我的吻部就偏过去。
lines.en: At the least stir, my snout angles toward it.

lines.zh: 我不急，河里的东西跑不快。
lines.en: I am not hurried; nothing in a river runs fast.

lines.zh: 我缩了缩身子，准备弹出去。
lines.en: I draw myself in, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 它躲进石缝，我在缝口等。
lines.en: It hides in a crack, and I wait at the opening.

lines.zh: 我的彩尾在它眼里，像一个信号。
lines.en: My colored tail looks like a signal to it.

lines.zh: 一圈一圈靠近，水都不要晃。
lines.en: Closer by circles, without rippling the water.

lines.zh: 它就快没力气了，我看得出来。
lines.en: It is nearly out of strength, and I can tell.

lines.zh: 我盯着那一点，别的都不看。
lines.en: I stare at that one point and nothing else.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底，从下往上接近。
lines.en: I keep to the riverbed and approach from below.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的腿，它一下弹开了。
lines.en: I bite its leg, and it springs away.

lines.zh: 我的牙小得看不见，可它疼。
lines.en: My teeth are too small to see, but they hurt.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，把它撞离水草。
lines.en: I butt it once and knock it off the weeds.

lines.zh: 这一口只撕下半只虫。
lines.en: The bite takes only half an insect.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，整个身子都甩了起来。
lines.en: I lunge, and my whole body whips forward.

lines.zh: 你被我咬到，像被针扎了一下。
lines.en: If I bite you, it is like a needle prick.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，被拖了很远。
lines.en: I hold on and am dragged a long way.

lines.zh: 我的力气小，可我的嘴不松。
lines.en: I have little strength, but my mouth stays shut on you.

lines.zh: 咬完我立刻游开，钻进草里。
lines.en: After biting I dart off into the weeds.

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，所以我不敢停。
lines.en: I have one point of life, so I dare not stop.

lines.zh: 我在温暖的浅水里出生，河底有阳光。
lines.en: I was born in warm shallows with sun on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我们两三条一起出现，颜色各不相同。
lines.en: Two or three of us appear, each a different color.

lines.zh: 这条河的水是暖的，我选了这里。
lines.en: This river is warm, and I chose it.

lines.zh: 我从水草缝里游出来，只有五厘米。
lines.en: I swim out of the weeds at barely five centimeters.

lines.zh: 第一次看见天，天比河大得多。
lines.en: The first time I saw the sky, it was far bigger than the river.

lines.zh: 水面上有虫，我一张嘴就吃到了。
lines.en: There were insects on the surface; one open mouth and I had one.

lines.zh: 我出生时，同伴已经在等我了。
lines.en: When I was born, my schoolmates were already waiting.

lines.zh: 河流上游来的水凉，我不去。
lines.en: Water from upstream is cold, and I do not go there.

lines.zh: 我这么小，连鱼鹰都懒得看我。
lines.en: I am so small even the osprey ignores me.

lines.zh: 河湾的阳光，是我最早的记忆。
lines.en: Sun on the river bend is my earliest memory.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来，我的彩鳞一下卷成了白。
lines.en: The surface scalds, and my colors curl to white.

lines.zh: 被甩到岸上，我拍了两下尾巴就不动了。
lines.en: Flung onto the bank, I slap my tail twice and stop.

lines.zh: 水离开了鳃，我在空气里张着嘴。
lines.en: Water leaves my gills, and I gape at the air.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被抛得很远，落进浅滩。
lines.en: The water bursts, and I am thrown far into the shallows.

lines.zh: 一根细刺穿过来，我还没看清就中了。
lines.en: A thin shaft comes through, and I am hit before I see it.

lines.zh: 一股冷意顺着鳃进去，我的颜色暗了。
lines.en: A coldness runs in through my gills, and my colors dim.

lines.zh: 河里没有吃的了，我瘦得只剩颜色。
lines.en: There is no food left, and I am reduced to color.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我整个人抖了一下就僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river, and I shudder once and stiffen.

lines.zh: 水全没了，我往下掉，尾巴都摆不动。
lines.en: The water is gone; I fall, and my tail cannot even beat.
